"""Camera-guided, incremental controller for the single live episode.
Only uses the public Robot interface, RGB/depth and robot proprioception.
Run with a JSON instruction filename; all executed commands are logged.
"""
import json, sys, os
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from rcb_client import Robot
from PIL import Image
RBASE=np.array([[0.,-1.,0.],[1.,0.,0.],[0.,0.,1.]])
TBASE=np.array([2.68478,-2.15993,.88819])
def world_to_base(p): return RBASE.T@(np.array(p)-TBASE)
def main():
    r=Robot()
    spec=r.spec()
    os.makedirs('/app/output',exist_ok=True)
    json.dump(spec,open('/app/output/spec.json','w'),indent=2)
    cfg=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])) if len(sys.argv)>1 else {}
    cameras=cfg.get('cameras',list(spec['cameras']))
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=cameras,include_depth=True,video='none')
    if 'waypoints' in cfg:
        p=dict(zip(obs.meta['proprio']['layout'],obs.meta['proprio']['now']))
        cmd=np.array([p[k] for k in spec['action_types']['ee_pose']['layout']])
        rows=[]
        for wp in cfg['waypoints']:
            target=cmd.copy()
            for hand,idx,hidx in [('right',0,12),('left',6,18)]:
                if hand in wp:
                    v=wp[hand]
                    if 'pos' in v: target[idx:idx+3]=world_to_base(v['pos']) if v.get('frame','world')=='world' else v['pos']
                    if 'rot' in v: target[idx+3:idx+6]=v['rot']
                    if 'fingers' in v: target[hidx:hidx+6]=v['fingers']
            n=round(wp.get('seconds',2)/spec['control_dt'])
            rows.extend(cmd+(target-cmd)*a for a in np.linspace(0,1,n+1)[1:])
            cmd=target
        arr=np.array(rows)
        for j in range(0,len(arr),200):
            part=arr[j:j+200]
            obs=r.submit('ee_pose',part,cameras=cameras,include_depth=True,video='none',note=cfg.get('note','camera-guided motion'))
    name=cfg.get('name','initial')
    out='/app/runs/'+name
    obs.save(out)
    for c,img in obs.last.items(): Image.fromarray(img).save(out+'/'+c+'.png')
    print(json.dumps({'out':out,'meta':obs.meta},indent=2))
if __name__=='__main__': main()
PY
